select count(1) totalNum, count(if(status='enabled', 1, null)) enabledNum from iot_event_source
and json_contains(device_group_ids, concat('', #{groupId}))
and json_contains(product_ids, concat('', #{productId}))

select a.* from iot_event_source a left join iot_product p on json_contains(a.product_ids, concat('', p.id))
and a.type = #{entity.type}
and json_contains(a.product_ids, concat('', #{entity.productId}))
and json_contains(a.device_group_ids, concat('', #{entity.deviceGroupId}))
and a.name like '%${entity.name}%'
group by a.id order by a.create_time desc

select a.*, esd.model_api_id, count(l.id) > 0 hasBindLinkage from iot_event_source a left join iot_linkage l on a.id = l.event_source_id left join iot_event_source_detail esd on a.id = esd.event_source_id where a.id=#{id} group by a.id
select a.name label, a.id value, count(l.event_source_id) extra from iot_event_source a left join iot_linkage l on a.id=l.event_source_id group by a.id

select a.*, ma.id ma_id, ma.type ma_type, ma.code ma_code, ma.direct ma_direct, ma.product_id ma_product_id , ma.name ma_name, ma.status ma_status, ma.func_type ma_func_type, ma.trigger_mode ma_trigger_mode , ma.collect_tag_id ma_collect_tag_id , dg.id dg_id, dg.name dg_name, dg.pid dg_pid from iot_event_source a left join iot_device_group dg on json_contains(a.device_group_ids, concat('', dg.id)) left join iot_model_api ma on ma.func_type='R' and ma.trigger_mode='passive' and json_contains(a.product_ids, concat('', ma.product_id)) where a.id=#{id} and ( /* 白名单过滤：白名单为空或包含该标签 */ (json_length(a.include_collect_tag_ids) = 0 or a.include_collect_tag_ids is null or (ma.collect_tag_id is not null and json_contains(a.include_collect_tag_ids, concat('', ma.collect_tag_id)))) and /* 黑名单过滤：黑名单为空或不包含该标签 */ (json_length(a.exclude_collect_tag_ids) = 0 or a.exclude_collect_tag_ids is null or (ma.collect_tag_id is null or not json_contains(a.exclude_collect_tag_ids, concat('', ma.collect_tag_id)))) )
select count(l.id) > 0 from iot_event_source a left join iot_linkage l on a.id=l.event_source_id where a.id=#{id} and l.status = 'enabled'
